crossRefs.note: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.
Your loving kindness, Yahweh, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. Yahweh, you preserve man and…
The heavens shall declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge.
I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”
The heavens will praise your wonders, Yahweh, your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.
Hear, heavens, and listen, earth; for Yahweh has spoken: “I have nourished and brought up children and they have…
for his judgments are true and righteous. For he has judged the great prostitute, who corrupted the earth with her…
Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on…
He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have…
but in very deed—as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with Yahweh’s glory—
Yahweh lives! Blessed be my rock! Exalted be God, the rock of my salvation,
One called to another, and said, “Holy, holy, holy, is Yahweh of Armies! The whole earth is full of his glory!”
that they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is no one besides me. I am Yahweh, and…
For, behold, darkness will cover the earth, and thick darkness the peoples; but Yahweh will arise on you, and his glory…
Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your rising.
For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of Yahweh’s glory, as the waters cover the sea.
Pray like this: ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.

translations.web: The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.
translations.bsb: The heavens proclaim His righteousness; all the peoples see His glory.
translations.kjv: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.
translations.asv: The heavens declare his righteousness, And all the peoples have seen his glory.
